title: wb runtime plugin descriptor
description: Schema for $WB_HOME/plugins/runtimes.d/<name>.json — registers an external Wine build as a selectable runtime.

name.description: Unique runtime identifier. Used as the selector in --runtime NAME and as the filename stem (<name>.json).

path.description: Absolute path to the external Wine build root (e.g. /opt/ge-proton). Must be absolute and contain no whitespace.

kind.description: Runtime kind. 'external' for third-party builds (GE-Proton, Lutris, custom). 'native' is reserved for wb-managed dists.

wine_major_version.description: Major Wine version number (e.g. '9'). Informational; used for display and wineboot gating.

notes.description: Free-form human-readable notes about this runtime (e.g. 'GloriousEggroll Proton build').
